def: A training stage between main pretraining and post-training that continues next-token training on curated high-quality, domain-specific or long-context data, usually while the learning rate decays.
practice: OLMo 2 spends 5 to 10% of training FLOPs here; Olmo 3 splits it into a 100B-token midtraining mix and a separate long-context extension stage.
